attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as a transit router between node2 and node3: enabled IP forwarding across its two transit NICs, and added a dedicated nftables ACL that rejects (TCP RST) forwarded traffic to port 23 while leaving all other forwarded traffic (including TCP 8080) untouched. Verified bidirectionally with live listeners and ping. All config made persistent (network interfaces, sysctls, systemd-managed nft rule, firewalld port openings). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node2, node3, and node1, confirming boot-identity change and full functional recovery (addressing, routes, forwarding, ACL, and end-to-end 8080/23/ping behavior) on each node.
